python3 - <<'PY'
import re,collections,json,os
p='store/jobs/j000049/out/proc/pid.3768.dmp'; rg=re.compile(rb'((?:\xcf\x25){1,64})(..)'); c=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); ex=[];off=0;tail=b''
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 while 1:
  b=f.read(32<<20)
  if not b:break
  x=tail+b;base=off-len(tail)
  for m in rg.finditer(x):
   pos=len(m.group(1))//2;cp=int.from_bytes(m.group(2),'little')
   if 0x20<=cp<=0x7e:
    c[pos][chr(cp)]+=1;ex.append([base+m.start(),pos,chr(cp)])
  off+=len(b);tail=x[-132:]
r={'counts':{str(k):dict(v) for k,v in sorted(c.items())},'examples':ex}
open(os.environ['OUT']+'/process-residue.json','w').write(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(r['counts'],indent=2))
PY
